name: combobox

<script lang="ts">
	import { Popover } from "#lib/components/ui/popover/index.js";
	import { setCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { Props } from "./index.js";
	import type { CompCtxProps } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	let { defaultValue = "", value = $bindable(defaultValue), onValueChange, open = $bindable(false), onOpenChange, disabled = false, name, size = "md", rounded, children }: Props = $props();
	const contextData: Omit<CompCtxProps, "value" | "open"> = $derived({ disabled, size, rounded, onValueChange, onOpenChange });
	const ctx = setCompCtx({ ...contextData, value, open });

	// Keep the shared settings in sync when the props change.
	$effect.pre(() => void Object.assign(ctx, contextData));

	// Keep the bindable props and the shared state in sync in both directions.
	$effect.pre(() => void (ctx.value = value));
	$effect.pre(() => void (value = ctx.value));
	$effect.pre(() => void (ctx.open = open));
	$effect.pre(() => void (open = ctx.open));
</script>

<!-- Popover that holds the trigger and the searchable list, aligned to the trigger's start edge. -->
<Popover bind:open={ctx.open} {onOpenChange} align="start" {size} {rounded}>
	{@render children()}
</Popover>

<!-- Hidden input so the value submits with forms. -->
{#if name}
	<input type="hidden" {name} value={ctx.value} />
{/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import { Command } from "#lib/components/ui/command/index.js";
	import { PopoverContent } from "#lib/components/ui/popover/index.js";
	import { useCompCtx as usePopoverCtx } from "#lib/components/ui/popover/ctx.svelte.js";
	import { useCompCtx } from "./ctx.svelte.js";
	import type { ContentProps } from "./index.js";
	const { size, rounded, children, class: className, style, ...props }: ContentProps = $props();
	const ctx = useCompCtx();
	const popoverCtx = usePopoverCtx();
	// Measured each time the popover opens, since the content mounts on open.
	const triggerWidth = $derived(popoverCtx.triggerEl?.offsetWidth ?? 0);
</script>

<!-- Popover as wide as the trigger, holding a command that starts on the selected item. -->
<PopoverContent class={["comboboxContent", className]} style="--combobox-trigger-width: {triggerWidth}px; {style ?? ''}" {size} {rounded} {...props}>
	<Command class="comboboxCommand" value={ctx.value} size={size ?? ctx.size} rounded={rounded ?? ctx.rounded}>
		{@render children()}
	</Command>
</PopoverContent>

<style>
	/* Lets the command fill the popover edge to edge, at least as wide as the trigger; the extra attributes outrank the popover's size rules */
	:global(.popoverContent.comboboxContent[data-size][data-side]) {
		padding: 0;
		width: max(var(--combobox-trigger-width), 12.5rem); /* 200px minimum */
	}

	/* The popover already draws the border and radius */
	:global(.command.comboboxCommand[data-size]) {
		border: 0;
		border-radius: 0;
	}
</style>
{@render children()} {#if isSelected} {/if}
{#snippet trigger({ props: triggerProps })} {#if customTrigger} {@render customTrigger({ props: { ...triggerProps, disabled: ctx.disabled } })} {:else} {/if} {/snippet}
{text}

description: A button that opens a searchable list to pick one option, built from the popover and command components.
